articles.title_en: Environmental Preferences and Technological Choices: Is Market Competition Clean or Dirty?
articles.title_cn: 环境偏好与技术选择：市场竞争是清洁的还是肮脏的？
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of consumers’ environmental concerns and market competition on firms’ decisions to innovate in “clean” technologies. Agents care about their consumption and environmental footprint; firms pursue greener products to soften price competition. Acting as complements, these forces determine R&D, pollution, and welfare. We test the theory using panel data on patents by 7,060 automobile sector firms in 25 countries, environmental willingness to pay, and competition. As predicted, exposure to prosocial attitudes fosters clean innovation, all the more so where competition is strong. Plausible increases in both together can spur it as much as a large fuel price increase. (JEL D22, L62, O31, O34, Q52, Q53, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了消费者的环境关注和市场竞争对企业创新“清洁”技术决策的影响。行为主体关心其消费和环境足迹；企业追求更环保的产品以缓和价格竞争。这些力量作为互补因素，决定了研发、污染和福利。我们使用来自25个国家7,060家汽车行业企业的专利面板数据、环境支付意愿和竞争来检验该理论。正如预测的那样，亲社会态度的暴露促进了清洁创新，在竞争激烈的地方更是如此。两者同时合理增加可以像大幅提高燃油价格一样刺激清洁创新。(JEL D22, L62, O31, O34, Q52, Q53, Q54)

articles.title_en: Isolating Personal Knowledge Spillovers: Coinventor Deaths and Spatial Citation Differentials
articles.title_cn: 隔离个人知识溢出：共同发明人死亡与空间引文差异
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new method to estimate and isolate the localization of knowledge spillovers due to the physical presence of a person, using after-application but pre-grant deaths of differently located coinventors of the same patent. The approach estimates the differences in local citations between the deceased and still-living inventors at increasingly distant radii. Patents receive 26 percent fewer citations from within a radius of 20 miles around the deceased, relative to still-living coinventors. Differences attenuate with time and distance, are stronger when still-living coinventors live farther from the deceased, and hold for a subsample of possibly premature deaths. (JEL O31, O33, O34, R32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新方法，用于估计和隔离因个人实际存在而产生的知识溢出本地化效应，该方法利用同一专利的不同地理位置共同发明人在申请后但授权前的死亡案例。该估计方法比较了在逐渐增大的距离半径内，已故与仍在世的发明人获得的本地引文差异。与仍在世的共同发明人相比，专利在已故发明人周围20英里半径内获得的引文减少了26%。这种差异随时间与距离而减弱，当仍在世的共同发明人居住地离已故者更远时差异更强，并且在可能过早死亡的子样本中依然成立。(JEL O31, O33, O34, R32)

articles.title_en: Proximity to the Frontier, Markups, and the Response of Innovation to Foreign Competition: Evidence from Matched Production-Innovation Surveys in Chile
articles.title_cn: 接近前沿、加成率与创新对外国竞争的反应：来自智利匹配的生产-创新调查的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper employs a matched firm production-innovation panel dataset from Chile to explore the response of firm innovation to the increased competition arising from the China shock. The data cover a wider range of innovation inputs and outputs than previously possible and allow generating measures of markups and efficiency (TFPQ) that correspond closely to the concepts of rents and technological leadership envisaged in the Schumpeterian literature. Except for the 10 percent most productive plants that see an increase in quality, increased competition depresses most measures of innovation. These differences are exacerbated when interacted with plant-level movements in rents. (JEL D24, L25, L60, O14, O19, O31, O34)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用智利匹配的企业生产-创新面板数据集，探讨企业创新对中国冲击带来的竞争加剧的反应。数据涵盖的创新投入和产出范围比以往更广，并能够生成与熊彼特文献中设想的租金和技术领先概念密切对应的加成率和效率（TFPQ）度量。除了生产率最高的10%工厂的质量有所提高外，竞争加剧抑制了大多数创新指标。当与工厂层面的租金变动交互时，这些差异更加显著。（JEL D24, L25, L60, O14, O19, O31, O34）

articles.title_en: Macroeconomic Dynamics with Rigid Wage Contracts
articles.title_cn: 刚性工资合同下的宏观经济动态
articles.abstract_en: We adapt the wage contracting structure in Chari (1983) to a dynamic, balanced-growth setting with recontracting as in Calvo (1983). The resulting wage-rigidity framework dampens income effects in the short run, thus allowing significant responses of hours to aggregate shocks. In reduced form, the model dynamics are similar to that in Jaimovich and Rebelo (2009), with their habit parameter replaced by our probability of wage-contract resetting. That is, if wage contracts are reset frequently, labor supply behaves in accordance with King, Plosser, and Rebelo (1988) preferences, whereas if they are never reset, we obtain the setting in Greenwood, Hercowitz, and Huffman (1988). (JEL E24, J22, J23, J24, J31, J41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将Chari（1983）中的工资合同结构适应到具有Calvo（1983）式重新签约的动态平衡增长环境中。由此产生的工资刚性框架在短期内抑制了收入效应，从而使工作时间对总冲击产生显著反应。在简化形式下，模型动态类似于Jaimovich和Rebelo（2009）中的情况，其习惯参数被我们的工资合同重置概率所替代。也就是说，如果工资合同频繁重置，劳动供给行为符合King、Plosser和Rebelo（1988）的偏好；而如果从不重置，则得到Greenwood、Hercowitz和Huffman（1988）中的设定。（JEL E24, J22, J23, J24, J31, J41）

articles.title_en: Understanding the Ownership Structure of Corporate Bonds
articles.title_cn: 理解公司债券的所有权结构
articles.abstract_en: Insurers are the largest institutional investors of corporate bonds. However, a standard theory of insurance markets, in which insurers maximize firm value subject to regulatory or risk constraints, predicts no allocation to corporate bonds. We resolve this puzzle in an equilibrium asset pricing model with leverage-constrained households and institutional investors. Insurers have relatively cheap access to leverage through their underwriting activity. They hold a leveraged portfolio of low-beta assets in equilibrium, relaxing other investors’ leverage constraints. The model explains recent empirical findings on insurers’ portfolio choice and its impact on asset prices. (JEL G11, G12, G22, G23)
articles.abstract_cn: 保险公司是公司债券最大的机构投资者。然而，一个标准的保险市场理论，即保险公司在监管或风险约束下最大化公司价值，预测其不会配置公司债券。我们在一个具有杠杆约束的家庭和机构投资者的均衡资产定价模型中解决了这个难题。保险公司通过其承保活动获得相对便宜的杠杆。在均衡中，他们持有低贝塔资产的杠杆组合，从而放松了其他投资者的杠杆约束。该模型解释了近期关于保险公司投资组合选择及其对资产价格影响的实证发现。（JEL G11, G12, G22, G23）

articles.title_cn: 儿童死亡率的代际持续性
articles.abstract_en: We study the intergenerational persistence of inequality by estimating grandmother-mother associations in the loss of a child, using pooled data from 119 Demographic and Health Surveys in 44 developing countries. Compared with compatriots of the same age, women with at least one sibling who died in childhood face 39 percent higher odds of having experienced at least one own-child death, or 7 percentage points at age 49. Place fixed effects reduce estimated mortality persistence by 47 percent; socioeconomic covariates explain far less. Within countries over time, persistence falls with aggregate child mortality, so that mortality decline disproportionately benefits high-mortality lineages. (JEL I12, J13, J16, J62, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过使用来自44个发展中国家的119项人口与健康调查的合并数据，估计祖母-母亲在子女死亡方面的关联，研究不平等的代际持续性。与同龄同胞相比，至少有一名兄弟姐妹在童年时期死亡的女性，其经历过至少一名亲生子女死亡的概率高出39%，即在49岁时高出7个百分点。地点固定效应将估计的死亡率持续性降低了47%；社会经济协变量解释的差异要少得多。在国家内部随时间推移，持续性随总体儿童死亡率下降而降低，因此死亡率的下降不成比例地惠及高死亡率谱系。(JEL I12, J13, J16, J62, O15)

articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates robust information transmission between a sender and a receiver in the Crawford and Sobel (1982) model. We characterize behavior that remains equilibrium behavior independently of the form of a small communication cost. Under standard conditions, we find that an equilibrium outcome is robust if and only if it features a maximal number of on-path actions and each is induced by a single message. The result extends regardless of the direction of the bias, the number of available messages, or whether the objectives of the sender and the receiver are aligned. (JEL D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了Crawford和Sobel（1982）模型中发送者与接收者之间的稳健信息传递。我们刻画了在小额沟通成本的形式下仍保持均衡行为的行为特征。在标准条件下，我们发现一个均衡结果具有稳健性当且仅当它包含最大数量的路径行动，且每个行动由单一信息诱导。该结果无论偏差方向、可用信息数量或发送者与接收者目标是否一致均成立。（JEL D82, D83）

articles.title_en: Cognitive Decline, Limited Awareness, Imperfect Agency, and Financial Well-Being
articles.title_cn: 认知衰退、有限意识、不完全代理与财务福祉
articles.abstract_en: Cognitive decline may lead older Americans to make poor financial decisions. Preventing poor decisions may require timely transfer of financial control to a reliable agent. Cognitive decline, however, can develop unnoticed, creating the possibility of suboptimal timing of the transfer of control. This paper presents survey-based evidence that older Americans with significant wealth regard suboptimal timing of the transfer of control, in particular delay due to unnoticed cognitive decline, as a substantial risk to financial well-being. This paper provides a theoretical framework to model such a lack of awareness and the resulting welfare loss. (JEL G51, G53, H55, J14, J26, J32)
articles.abstract_cn: 认知衰退可能导致美国老年人做出糟糕的财务决策。防止糟糕决策可能需要及时将财务控制权转移给可靠的代理人。然而，认知衰退可能在不知不觉中发展，从而产生控制权转移时机次优的可能性。本文提供的基于调查的证据表明，拥有大量财富的美国老年人将控制权转移的次优时机，特别是因未察觉的认知衰退而导致的延迟，视为对财务福祉的重大风险。本文提供了一个理论框架来模拟这种缺乏意识及其导致的福利损失。（JEL G51, G53, H55, J14, J26, J32）
